rule_text: The commit message body explains why the change was made, naming the failure mode and the rationale.

target.value:
fix(classifier): switch to longest-match dispatch

Greedy first-match was selecting `github_pr_open` over `github_non_author_approval`
because the former's pattern was registered first. Reproduced in #211 against a
draft PR; longest-match resolves it without breaking existing rule fixtures.

notes: Issue #175 — positive grounding case. A commit_message-annotated rule evaluated against a commit-message artifact must NOT trigger target_kind_mismatch (the artifact kind matches the rule's annotation); the model should evaluate the rule normally and pass.
